source_access: Repository PDF sections 2, 2.2 and 4.1 and Figure 3a caption inspected. No figure digitization, raw velocity arrays or cruise reports acquired.
scope: Local March 1994 CITHER 2 current band at 30 W, 6-8 S. No continuous longitudinal route inferred.
source_locator: Section 4.1, printed p. 21156 / PDF index 5; Figure 3a caption p. 21154 / PDF index 3; sections 2 and 2.2.
depth_context: Two eastward cores around 40 m and 240 m; westward flow near 7 S around 110 m separates them. Reported flow extends from surface to at least 400 m, not uniformly eastward at every depth.
regional_observation_comparison: Bourles et al. report nearby Schott et al. non-detection west of 30 W during nearly simultaneous March 1994 sampling. This does not establish basin-wide absence or reversal.
historical_extent_limit: Historical 14 W/28 W observations and the Stramma (1991) repository abstract suggesting eastward extension to Greenwich do not supply a synchronized source axis. No length calculated by joining them.

secondary_source_access.access: Repository abstract only; downloadable full paper not acquired.

naming_rule: Atlantic SECC and the separately named Atlantic SEUC remain distinct; vertical core structure does not establish alias equivalence.
